steps.name: Check out public source without retaining credentials
Select pnpm without installing project packages or caching
Select the project Node version without package-manager cache
Install the locked public packages in this ephemeral runner
Run the two existing contract checks
steps.run:
set +e
timeout --kill-after=5s 60s pnpm exec vitest run packages/contracts/src/contracts.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile="$RUNNER_TEMP/flow-ci-contracts.json"
code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/flow-ci-contracts.exit"
exit "$code"

steps.name: Run one real PostgreSQL and public HTTP handler check
steps.run:
set +e
timeout --kill-after=5s 120s pnpm exec vitest run apps/server/src/server.test.ts -t 'persists accepted commands across restart and rejects changed retries$' --reporter=json --outputFile="$RUNNER_TEMP/flow-ci-handler.json"
code=$?
printf '%s\n' "$code" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/flow-ci-handler.exit"
exit "$code"

steps.name: Observe connections and normally remove only this job database
steps.run:
# No FORCE, terminate-backend, host database or persistent volume access.
timeout --kill-after=2s 15s bash <<'CLEANUP'
set -euo pipefail
[[ "$FLOW_CI_POSTGRES_ID" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{12,64}$ ]]
query() { docker exec "$FLOW_CI_POSTGRES_ID" psql -X -qAt -U flow -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "$1"; }
test "$(query "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname='flow_c01'")" = 1
connections=unknown
for observation in {1..15}; do
  connections=$(query "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='flow_c01'")
  [[ "$connections" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
  if test "$connections" = 0; then break; fi
  sleep 0.2
done
if test "$connections" != 0; then
  printf 'cleanup=unknown connections=%s; no normal DROP attempted\n' "$connections"
  exit 1
fi
docker exec "$FLOW_CI_POSTGRES_ID" dropdb -U flow flow_c01
test "$(query "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_database WHERE datname='flow_c01'")" = 0
printf 'normal-drop; connections=0; database-absent\n' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/flow-ci-cleanup.txt"
CLEANUP
